quarterly_data.signal: Oracle's remaining performance obligations were $664 billion as of August 31, 2026 versus $455 billion as of August 31, 2025, the increase primarily attributable to certain significant cloud contracts entered into during the period. Oracle expects to recognize approximately 13% as revenues over the next twelve months, 37% over months 13 to 36, 34% over months 37 to 60 and the remainder thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $455 billion as of August 31, 2025; 13% next twelve months, 37% months 13 to 36, 34% months 37 to 60

quarterly_data.signal: As of August 31, 2026 Oracle's unconditional purchase and certain other obligations with terms of one year or greater, which were primarily related to long-term supply arrangements for purchasing components for cloud infrastructure assets and power supply arrangements for data centers, totaled $34,150 million: $5,449 million in the remainder of fiscal 2027, $6,176 million in fiscal 2028, $3,863 million in fiscal 2029, $4,318 million in fiscal 2030, $6,768 million in fiscal 2031, $954 million in fiscal 2032 and $6,622 million thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: $34,150 million unconditional purchase obligations (primarily cloud infrastructure component supply and data center power supply arrangements)
